sentences.en: China continues to lose arable land because of erosion and urbanization.
sentences.zh: 中国由于侵蚀和城市化继续失去可耕地。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to undertake a massive urbanization effort.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要开展大规模的城市化进程。

sentences.en: The city experienced a rapid urbanization after being declared as the capital.
sentences.zh: 该市在被宣布为首都后经历了快速的城市化过程。
